job.title: Visual Merchandiser
job.description:
Join Our Floral Merchandising Team in Southeast Melbourne!

Are you passionate about creating beautiful spaces and bringing joy through flowers? We are partnered with Australia’s largest wholesaler of fresh flowers and potted products and are looking for dedicated and reliable individuals to join our dynamic merchandising field team in Southeast Melbourne.

About Us: Our floral merchandising team specializes in designing inviting floral and potted displays in major supermarkets across Australia. We take pride in our work, and we want you to be a part of our mission to brighten up every store we serve!

The Role: As a member of our floral merchandising team, you will enhance the shopping experience for customers by maintaining stunning floral displays in stores. Your areas of service will include Pakenham.

Key Details:

  • Work Schedule:  Minimum 4 days/week – Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday
  • Hours: Approximately 15-20 hours per week

Responsibilities:

  • Merchandising our product range in major supermarket chains within your assigned area
  • Creating and maintaining beautiful point-of-sale displays
  • Monitoring stock levels and collaborating with store managers to ensure product availability
  • Transporting stock from the loading dock to the shop floor, unpacking, and creatively displaying (lifting up to 12kgs)
  • Ensuring the display area is clean and checking product quality
  • Engaging with customers and liaising with store and department managers

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive training provided
  • An opportunity to work in a creative, supportive team environment

Ideal Candidate: We invite applicants who possess the following skills and attributes:

  • A reliable car and a valid Australian driver’s license are essential
  • Retail, supermarket, or merchandising experience is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Exceptional customer service skills and strong communication abilities
  • A well-presented professional with a flair for creativity
  • Reliable, physically fit, and comfortable working independently

How to Apply: Interested candidates will be contacted via email and phone for screening and interviews. Please ensure your resume is updated with your current contact information.

Join us and make every shopping experience a little more beautiful!

If you're an experienced Storeperson looking for your next opportunity with an established industry leader, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply here with a copy of your updated resume and we will be in contact with you!

job.title: Bar Tenders & Duty Managers

  • Current RSA
  • Solid bar experience in a high-volume venue. Experience is essential
  • Exceptional beer, wine and cocktail service
  • Tray service for functions and events
  • Bepoz POS experience highly regarded

If you're interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply with a copy of your resume. Shortlisting will start immediately, so don't miss out!

job.title: Yardhand
job.description:
Our client is a well-established supplier of essential energy products, supporting homes and businesses across Australia. They’re looking for a reliable, hands-on person to join their Winnellie team and help prepare gas cylinders for distribution.

Perks:

  • $35.61 per hour
  • 6:00 am–2:00 pm Mon to Fri - No weekends!
  • Ongoing work with an ASAP start
  • Join an established team in an essential industry

About the role:

  • Fill, relabel and paint gas cylinders
  • Lift and move cylinders weighing up to 20 kg throughout the shift
  • Load cylinders into cages and prepare them for dispatch
  • Operate production equipment and keep the yard organised
  • Assist with forklift loading and unloading when required, around 10% of the role

About you:

  • Experience in a physical labouring, yard or production role
  • Comfortable with repetitive lifting and working at a fast pace
  • Driver’s licence and reliable transport
  • Forklift licence preferred, but not essential
  • Able to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol test, and police check

If you’re ready for a hands-on role with an immediate start, apply now and we will be in contact.

job.title: Cold Storage Pick Packers
job.description:
We have partnered with a growing Australian logistics and distribution company who specialise in the storage and delivery of chilled, frozen and ambient products. They have built a brand new warehouse in Acaica Ridge and they are seeking Pick Packers to establish their teams!

  • Full-time hours
  • Full Availability across 7 days
  • Day Shifts: 11am Start or 12pm Start
  • Afternoon Shift: 2pm Start

Key Responsibilities:

You will play an integral role in the safe, efficient and accurate movement of stock throughout a fast-paced distribution centre. Working within a modern, temperature-controlled facility, you will be required to work across both chiller and freezer environments. This is an exciting opportunity to secure a casual ongoing position with view to permanency.

  • Pick and Pack Orders
  • Operate Low Level Order Pickers and Electric Pallet Jacks
  • Prepare orders for Dispatch
  • Manual handling up to 25kg

Requirements:

  • Previous experience working in warehousing or manual handling roles
  • Willingness to work in Chiller/Freezer environments
  • Availability to work on weekends
  • Interest in a long-term opportunity
  • Reliability, punctuality, and a strong commitment to safety

If you're interested in this opportunity to be a part of a brand-new team within a national company, please apply with a copy of your resume and we will be in contact with you!
